correctness.rationale: For all cycles except the false-twin four-cycle, an OLD code is proved equivalent to an omitted set without pairs at distances two and four; a residue isomorphism gives one or two cycle squares. Distinguished cyclic-gap compositions give the exact cardinality coefficients and all boundary and minimum cases. Direct independent graph tests of 262136 labelled subsets and a separate weighted transfer calculation agree.

originality.rationale: The 2019 primary result contains a scalar cycle minimum with a deficient construction, and the 2021 primary paper conjectures an extra unit for every order congruent to one modulo three. The present exact all-size polynomial and corrected parity-sensitive formula are not implied by either. Full mathematical comparisons and available research records did not identify an equivalent ordinary-cycle OLD cardinality polynomial. Publication priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: A previously unindexed exact equivalent theorem could exist; novelty is provisional until independent specialist review.
The 2026 bounded-degree open-code article was assessed from its scope/abstract rather than line-by-line full text; its subject is different.
The full unrestricted proof is written here but has not received an independent mathematical audit.

value.rationale: The complete labelled configuration-size polynomial supplies natural quantitative sensor-placement information at every budget, exact minimum-code multiplicities, no-gap size spectrum, and a rigorous modulo-six correction to a specific 2021 published conjecture with a concrete thirteen-cycle witness. This is more than a routine scalar bound or ad hoc numerical check.
